gen-gf-offside-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans keeps its curves wide open and its strokes uniform, friendly and contemporary. Spline Sans sits under Offside's widely tracked, unclosed display letters, with its moderate lowercase giving the tall heading room to command.
gen-gf-offside-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean and dependable, a constant stripe of ink with generous openings in every curve. Synonym's moderate lowercase against Offside's high one is the pair's strongest quality, a loud heading handing off to a steady sans-serif.
gen-gf-offside-gf-aclonica: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its widely tracked letters look traced with a single marker. Aclonica brings a deep-bellied lowercase and bowls that thin gently, so Offside commands the display while the sans stretches out in a long, loose line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-allerta: Wire-smooth and wide. Offside glides under the eye with curves that never quite close, while Allerta follows in loose, widely spaced letters with a prominent x-height, a plain sans that lets the display lead.
gen-gf-offside-gf-alumni-sans: Offside is flat and contrast-free, with curves left open. Its strongest quality is the gap between that unvarying line and Alumni Sans, a sans whose bowls swell slightly and whose wide-open c looks like a bracelet pulled apart.
gen-gf-offside-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Offside's curves refuse to close, spaced wide and level. Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs a tight word texture, so a longer stretch reads as a dense, oversized lowercase running beside small capitals in a plain sans.
gen-gf-offside-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC reads squeezed and contemporary, its lowercase looking oversized beside its own capitals, with stems just outweighing hairlines. Over a longer stretch it settles into a tight, steady texture.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its glyphs into a dense huddle, rounded forms staying open to the side and lowercase filling the line like capitals. And Offside, with zero stroke contrast, sails over it as a widely tracked display line against that low-contrast sans-serif.
gen-gf-offside-gf-arsenal: Offside looks like a sign-painter's single brush stroke at constant width. Arsenal, a plain sans with its x-height near the cap height and a modest weight shift in round letters, packs in close beneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC reads clean and contemporary, with a faint thick-thin shift and a tight fit between characters. Arsenal SC over a long passage stays snug and quietly flexing like stretched rubber cord, a sans that follows Offside's ruler-straight line.
